notes.subject: כרע / קרס
notes.rationale: Tupela tok klostu wankain (kanu / go daun) — ol god i pundaun olsem ol piksa yet; tok i lukluk wankain tasol Tok Pisin i no holim narapela klos

notes.subject: לחיה ולבהמה
notes.rationale: Sumi ol i tok 'long wail animal na animal bilong lukautim', narapela i tok 'ol piksa i stap antap long ol animal' — Heb i tok 'ol piksa bilong ol i kamap long/bilong ol animal'

translation: Bel i kanu, Nevo i go daun; ol piksa bilong ol i kamap long ol wail animal, na long ol animal bilong lukautim; ol kago bilong yupela, ol i loadim ol gut, kago i pen long man i les long wok.

tokens.gloss: na long ol animal bilong lukautim
i pen long man i les long wok
